label: final_release
timing_scope: Fresh worker per trial; compilation timing excludes imports, fixture loading and independent verification. max_seconds is a cooperative limit.
verification_scope: Exact original-task binding, frozen U/D targets, minimum original-field blocklength, and independent polynomial arithmetic on every original source basis vector. This does not independently prove the universal rate theorem.

comparison.interpretation: Only cases completing every repeat in both runs enter speedup calculations. Budget stops and failures are reported separately.
comparison.measurement_note: Both accepted runs used sequential fresh workers while other project test, profiling and document-build jobs were paused. The earlier development-overlap baseline and superseded candidate measurements were excluded.
